description:
Mario Tennis for the Game Boy Color: a tennis RPG. Climb the academy's singles and doubles ladders, train in
the drills and Mario mini-games, and win the Island Open.

apworld-v0.1.0.description:
The first release of the Mario Tennis GBC apworld. It's complete and playable, but lightly playtested, so expect rough edges.

## What's randomized

Story progress comes from items instead of wins:

- **Progressive Singles / Doubles Pass:** 4 per arc. Each one opens the next class: Senior, Varsity, the Island Open, then Peach's Castle. Junior is open from the start.
- **Training Court drills:** progressive Service, Net Game and Stroke Matches and Lessons, Wall Practice and Tennis Machine. Each opens the next level; level 1 is always open.
- **Mario mini-games:** the 9 mini-games, as progressive or single items.
- **Equipment:** the six special rackets and two pairs of shoes.
- **EXP Bundles** fill the rest. They are banked on the story file and awarded from Char/Partner Data in the pause menu, or on Continue.

85 locations in total:

- every ranking-match win, Island Open round and Dream Match;
- every drill clear;
- the swing contest's two scores;
- every mini-game level clear and record court.

## Goals

- Win the Island Open final.
- Win the Dream Match at Peach's Castle.
- Check every location.

Each goal applies to every story arc you play.

## Options

- **Logic:** `story_arcs` (both, singles or doubles), `goal`, and `minigames` (progressive, vanilla or excluded).
- **Gameplay:**
  - `story_match_sets` and `story_match_games` shorten story matches.
  - `nerf_swing_contest` lowers the swing contest's thresholds from 100 and 150 swings to 60 and 90.
- **Quality of life:**
  - `skip_intro` skips the opening tour.
  - `default_text_speed` and `default_camera_mode` set the starting text speed and match camera.
  - `item_messages` turns the item popups off.
- **Multiworld:** `remote_items` makes the server deliver your own items too, for co-op or playing one slot on two carts.

## Other changes to the game

- **Varsity and the Island Open:**
  - The Varsity victory scene no longer sends you straight off to the Island Open.
  - The Island Open is reached through the Academy's front gate.
  - Once both the Island Open and Peach's Castle are unlocked, the gate asks where to fly.
- **Peach's Castle:** with the castle still locked, the ending doesn't fly you there.
- **Received items:** passes, drills and mini-games count as soon as they arrive, even at the main menu.
- **Disabled features:**
  - the N64 Transfer Pak record transfer and its unlocks;
  - the unlock-everything cheat.
- **Save data:** a cart patched for a different seed erases its save data and starts fresh.

Universal Tracker is supported, and it works without a YAML.
apworld-v0.1.0.title: Mario Tennis GBC apworld v0.1.0

apworld-v0.2.0.description:
## New options

- **`shot_items`** (default off): your shots become items.
  - **Strokes:** topspin, slice and the flat shot. The second copy of each adds its power shot (the smash, for the flat shot).
  - **Lob and drop shot.**
  - **Serves:** topspin, slice and flat. The second copy adds the nice serve.
  - You start with one random stroke and one random serve. A locked shot plays the first stroke or serve you own.
  - **Logic:**
    - Story matches want more shots as you climb: 3 for Senior, 5 for Varsity, 8 for the Island Open, 11 for the Dream Match.
    - Shot-hungry mini-games and drills want the shots they need.
    - Anything that can still be won without the shots shows as glitched logic in Universal Tracker.
- **`experience_modifier`** (default normal): scales every EXP award, from ×0.5 up to ×5. That covers story, exhibition and linked matches, drills, and EXP Bundles.
- **`nerf_two_on_one`** (default off): Bowser's Two-on-One plays 2 games per set instead of 6.
- **`skip_ceremony`** (default off): winning the Island Open final skips the fireworks and the Awards Ceremony. You go straight from the bracket to the congratulations artwork and credits.
- **`dream_match_difficulty`** (default intense): sets how hard Mario plays in Peach's first Dream Match offer: hard, intense or max. After a win she offers all three, as usual.

## Locations

- **New:** each class's practice match, in both arcs (6 locations). Each one still needs that class's pass.
- **Removed:** the three mini-game record-court locations.
- That makes 88 locations in total.

## Logic

- **Mini-games:**
  - Perfect Shot needs the lob.
  - Target Shot levels 2 and 3 need the drop shot, and want the lob.
  - Two-on-One wants the Dream Match's shot count.
- **Drills:** a level's logic includes the level before it. Service Matches want a nice serve, and are glitched without one.

## Other changes to the game

- **Academy front gate:** once both the Island Open and Peach's Castle are open, the gate opens an Island Open / Mario World menu. Pressing B walks you back into the Academy.
- **Assigning EXP:**
  - Select gives the highlighted character all the remaining EXP.
  - Holding the increase keeps speeding up, past the original game's top speed, to as much as 64 points a frame.
apworld-v0.2.0.title: Mario Tennis GBC apworld v0.2.0

apworld-v0.3.0.description:
## New options

- **DeathLink**, as two independent options, both off by default. You can change either while playing with the client's `/deathlink_send` and `/deathlink_receive` commands.
  - **`death_link_send`** (off, point, game or match): the smallest loss that sends a death.
    - A lost match point is still only one death.
    - A failed mini-game or drill counts as a lost match, and a failed drill point as a lost point.
  - **`death_link_receive`** (off, point, game or match): what a received death costs you in a match.
    - A lost game in a tiebreak takes the set with it.
    - Any death ends a mini-game or drill as failed. The exception is a high-score run already past its record, which ends as a high score.
    - Deaths that arrive outside a match, mini-game or drill are ignored.
  - Two-on-One counts as a match for both options.
- **`court_shuffle`** (default vanilla): the courts story matches are played on.
  - **Shuffled:** the story's own courts are dealt out between its matches, so each court is played as often as usual, in different matches.
  - **Randomized:** every match picks its own court from the nine exhibition courts and Center Court.
- **`opponent_strategy`** (default vanilla): where singles story opponents stand and move. In the original game every one of them uses the same adaptive positioning.
  - **Randomized:** each singles match's opponent gets one of the game's eight positioning strategies, such as staying back at the baseline, sliding sideways or rushing the net.
  - Their skill is unchanged.
  - Doubles opponents always keep their usual positioning.

## Logic

With `shot_items` on, three drills now strictly need a shot instead of counting as glitched logic without it:

- **Net Game Lesson 2** needs the smash.
- **Stroke Match 2** needs the lob.
- **Net Game Match 2** needs the smash. Clearing it without the lob is still glitched logic.

There are still 88 locations.
apworld-v0.3.0.title: Mario Tennis GBC apworld v0.3.0
